title: Trace a Catalog Read Across a Projection Boundary
simulationLabel: SAP Commerce learning simulation; not SAP Commerce runtime
objective: Diagnose whether a product read failure is caused by missing source data or stale projection data.
acceptanceCriteria: Does not claim simulation behavior is platform behavior
referenceSolution: The source remains present and current while projectionUpdatedAt is intentionally older; the projection boundary is stale. Reconcile/replay the projection with an idempotent operation and verify both read paths.
